title: centaurea nitiida
intro: Centaurea nitiida, commonly known as Mountain Centaury, is a flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in relieving pain, reducing swelling, and protecting against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea nitiida include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
